footnotes.footnote: Pursuant to the Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated as of August 1, 2026, by and among Indivior Pharmaceuticals, Inc. ("Indivior"), Artemis Merger Sub Inc. and Supernus Pharmaceuticals, Inc. ("Supernus Pharmaceuticals"), at the effective time of the merger on 11/2/26, Artemis Merger Sub Inc. merged with and into Supernus Pharmaceuticals, with Supernus Pharmaceuticals surviving as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Indivior. At the effective time, each outstanding share of Supernus Pharmaceuticals common stock was cancelled and automatically converted into the right to receive 1.5401 shares of Indivior common stock. In connection with the merger, Indivior changed its name to "Supernus, Inc." The reporting person's shares of Supernus Pharmaceuticals common stock were disposed of, and the shares of Supernus, Inc. common stock received in exchange were acquired, pursuant to the merger. The reporting person received no cash consideration other than cash in lieu of a fractional share.

Pursuant to the Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated as of August 1, 2026, by and among Indivior Pharmaceuticals, Inc. ("Indivior"), Artemis Merger Sub Inc. and Supernus Pharmaceuticals, Inc. ("Supernus Pharmaceuticals"), at the effective time of the merger on 11/2/2026, each outstanding Supernus Pharmaceuticals equity award was assumed by Indivior (renamed Supernus, Inc.) and automatically converted into a corresponding Supernus, Inc. equity award covering the number of Supernus, Inc. shares equal to the number of Supernus Pharmaceuticals shares subject to the award multiplied by the 1.5401 exchange ratio (rounded down), with the per-share exercise price divided by the exchange ratio and rounded up to the nearest whole cent. Each converted award is subject to substantially the same terms and conditions, including vesting, that applied immediately prior to the effective time, except performance stock unit awards were converted into time-vesting restricted stock units.
The option vests in four equal annual installments beginning on the specified date.

These restricted stock units ("RSUs") are settled in common stock upon vesting, which occurs in four installments. 50% of the RSUs vest upon the closing of the merger-of-equals transaction between Supernus Pharmaceuticals, Inc. and Indivior Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (the "Closing"). 15% of the RSUs vest upon the one-year anniversary of the Closing. 15% of the RSUs vest upon the two-year anniversary of the Closing. 20% of the RSUs vest upon the three-year anniversary of the Closing.
These restricted stock units are settled in common stock upon vesting, which occurs on December 31, 2027.
